teaching_note: The inspected Unredacted collection distinguishes wartime antecedents, the March 1946 British-US Communications Agreement, later technical appendices and the 1956 UKUSA evolution, with public releases in 2010 [@ageint011; @ageint135]. A distinct wartime agreement and a later postwar instrument must not be flattened into one date or a timeless five-party mandate. Establish clause-level parties, edition and scope from the document itself before interpreting obligations; present agency names and historical cooperation do not establish current legal authority.
title: GCHQ and the BRUSA/UKUSA Agreements

raw: 29.4 Five Eyes Archive: Key Declassified Documents[^10][^41][^42]
